title: try_module_get/module_put prevents provider use-after-unload
description: crypto2dev_lookup_algo calls try_module_get(p->owner) under read_lock before returning the ops pointer. If try_module_get fails (module is going away), the loop continues rather than returning the stale ops. The returned owner is stored in state->owner_module (OPERATION fd) or state->key_owner_module (KEY fd) and released via module_put in crypto2dev_fd_release on close. This prevents rmmod of a provider module while any fd is open and dispatching into it. A reviewer might suggest removing try_module_get as 'unnecessary overhead' — do not do this. Without it, a provider can be unloaded while a write() is in progress inside its ops->update(), causing a kernel crash. The refcount is mandatory.
